summary:
SF Italianate painted lady on a 16x50 lot: a teal-siding false front over a dark-teal garage base, with a full-height angled bay (x1..6) and a cream stair rising to a recessed columned porch (x10..14). Gold fish-scale bands, a burgundy frieze and a deep bracketed cream cornice sit under a pedimented parapet that hides a low `shop`-preset gable.
Ochre and pale-blue neighbours press against both sides. A lightwell lights the dining room and bath, one long staircase runs up the east party wall, and the kitchen opens onto a deck above a deep garden with a citrus tree, a veg bed and a bench.

shell: P1 shell built in parts/shell.mjs: neighbour walls x0/x15, floors y0/4/8/12 with stair holes, front/back/party/bay/lightwell walls, partitions per storey, stairs E20/E21 and banisters; every opening and reserved cell left air.
make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; shell report placed 3280 cells, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
Checked: `mcd check` says walkable end to end; front elevation and front-left tiles read as the teal/gold/cream front with the bay, parapet and roof.
polish: Two orphan cornice stairs from the spec: (0,14,6) and (15,16,6) have no support under them (the neighbour front belongs to P4). Noted in plan.md Notes; P4 may add a support block.
Stair landings (13,8,16) and (13,12,20) are left as air holes so the flights step off; this is a judgement call, noted in plan.md.

Not built by P1 (later parts): front glazing, cornice, doors, porch columns and arch (P3); street front (P4); deck, garden and back glazing (P5); interior doors and lights (P6). elements.md has no tick column, so the ticked items are listed in a new BUILT section at its end.

summary:

Dark deepslate roof, ridge y20 behind the false front, fish-scale back gable, two brick chimneys with campfire tops; grid stays 16x22x50 and make.sh writes a whole build.nbt with no refused or off-palette writes.
Changed the spec from the plan in two places: edges fascia off (fascia at the x=0 eave shifted the grid by +1 in x), and an explicit deepslate material mix (the preset's polished_blackstone_brick slabs/stairs are not in palette.json). Both are recorded in plan.md Notes and elements.md.
polish: Fascia row omitted on purpose (plan asked for default edges). Revisit only if the fascia is wanted; it needs a grid-shift fix first.
Soffit uses spruce (4% of roof role), which is palette-legal but not a roof-role block.
Cornice orphan smooth_quartz_stairs at (0,14,6) and the stairs at (15,16,6) are P1/P3 territory, not roof.

Local put() helper mirrors vocab's; ./make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt, front facade line 176 placed with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE. Ticked P3 in plan.md and added a BUILT (P3 facade) block to elements.md.
